_meta.purpose: A rotating bank of light, on-brand 'fun' formats about intern / grad life. The generator picks one unused idea per day and authors a bespoke design around it. Fun = relatable and playful, still brand-safe (no memes that punch down, no stereotypes).
rules: Keep it kind and inclusive - relatable, never mocking a group.
Every fun post still carries the logo + internwise.co.uk URL.
Vary the format across the week (poll, this-or-that, tier list, bingo, POV, checklist).
